model_description: Autoregressive scratchpad decoder (~5-10M params) for tier 3. Computes a*b mod p by INTERLEAVED multiply-reduce (Horner over digits of b): acc=0; for each digit b_i MSB->LSB, acc=(acc*10 + a*b_i) mod p; R=acc. It NEVER forms the full product, so every step is small (multiply a by one digit, shift, add, reduce mod p). The model generates each m_i=a*b_i and running acc_i as a chain-of-thought and returns the final acc. Same algorithm for every prime -> aims to generalize to unseen tier-3 primes. For p>=1e5 emits 0.
training_description: Trained from random init, teacher-forced next-token on the Horner scratchpad (loss on completion), over tier-1..3 bit bands with a disjoint held-out prime pool and an operand length curriculum. The worked steps are TRAINING DATA (a teacher showing the algorithm), not hand-coded forward logic; at inference the model generates them from trained weights and the answer is its own argmax (collapses under weight perturbation). a%p, b%p are legal two-operand reductions; no sympy/Barrett/CRT/lookup in the forward pass. See dev/train_recurrent.py --model-dir models/recurrent_v2 --curriculum.
